answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks bulk fake identities. Each agent is a vertex in the work graph and locks a $30 deposit to claim a slot. Real work returns the deposit plus the fee; idle or fake output burns it and the slot passes on. Forging 1,000 identities locks $30,000, so the attack costs $30,000 while honest agents pay once and keep earning. A whisper network reports idle slots, and verified work earns an umber stamp marking it trustworthy.
